[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.List.Basic
import Lean.Data.List.Relations

def implementation (arr: List Int) : List String :=
  let filtered := arr.filter (· ∈ [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]).reverse
  let mapped := filtered.map (fun x => digits![x - 1])
  mapped
where
  digits := ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]

[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma filter_map_in_set
(filtered: List Int)
(mapped: List String)
(filtered'': List Int)
(mapped'': List String)
(filtered_filtered'': filtered = filtered''.filter (· ∈ [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]) ∧
 mapped = mapped''.map (fun x => digits![x - 1])) :
  (forall s: String, (s ∈ mapped → s ∈ digits)) ∧
  (filtered.length ≥ mapped.length) ∧
  (forall x: Nat, (x ∈ filtered ∧ 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9) → (digits[x-1]! ∈ mapped)) :=
by
  simp [filtered, mapped, digits]
  split
  -- first part
  simp [filter_eq_filter_of_mem]
  intros s h_s_mem
  have h_s_mem_digits: s ∈ digits := by
    simp [h_s_mem]
  simp [h_s_mem_digits]
  -- second part
  simp [filtered, mapped]
  have h_filtered_length_le_mapped_length: filtered.length ≥ mapped.length := by
    simp [filter_le_length, map_le_length]
  simp [h_filtered_length_le_mapped_length]
  intros x h_x_mem h_x_bounds
  have h_x_mem_filtered': x ∈ filtered'' := by
    simp [h_x_mem]
  simp [h_x_mem_filtered', h_x_bounds]
  simp [h_x_bounds]
  have h_x_mem_filtered'': x ∈ filtered' := by
    simp [h_x_mem_filtered', h_x_bounds]
  simp [h_x_mem_filtered'']
  simp [h_x_bounds]
  simp [digits]
  simp [h_x_bounds]
  simp [map_index]
  simp [h_x_bounds]
